entries.note: stb_truetype only reads trusted OS/user-selected local fonts; it is not used to preview arbitrary project font files. The glyph cache is bounded and rasterizes at drawable density while UI coordinates remain logical. Glyph availability follows the chosen monospace font; automatic font fallback, shaping and full Unicode typography are not claimed.

Colours, microui metrics, the font pixel size and the line height come from orchestrator/native/theme.h, which `python3 tools/design.py generate` derives from design/tokens.json; the same tokens feed the Claude Design preview cards. Edit the tokens and regenerate, never the header: `tools/design.py check` rejects a stale header and any mu_color/vterm_color_rgb literal outside the palette. Applying upstream microui's default slots explicitly here is behaviour-neutral (identical values) and makes every slot designable. Every owned native source uses RE_COLOR_* through common.h; `check` fails on any numeric colour literal, so a new colour starts as a token.
